samples.title: Invoice, text PDF (fictional)
samples.description: A two-page PDF with a real text layer: an invoice with a ruled line-item table (page 1) and terms and conditions (page 2). Text is read exactly from the file; no OCR is needed.
samples.provenance: Generated by services/document-ocr/scripts/make_samples.py for this demonstration. Company, customer, address, e-mail (example.com) and telephone numbers are fictional.
samples.licence: Created for this project; no third-party content.
demonstrates: PDF text-layer extraction with exact positions
field rules (dates, amounts, e-mail, phone, identifier)
does_not_demonstrate: a real-world layout or any real company's invoice

samples.title: Invoice, simulated scan (image-only PDF)
samples.description: Page 1 of the invoice above, rasterised at 150 dpi and degraded the way a poor flatbed scan is: 1.4 degrees of skew, blur, uneven lighting, noise and JPEG compression. It is an image-only PDF with NO text layer, so the text must be recognised.
samples.provenance: Derived from invoice-text.pdf by scan() in services/document-ocr/scripts/make_samples.py (deterministic). This is a simulation, not a photograph of paper.
samples.licence: Created for this project; no third-party content.
demonstrates: fields parsed from OCR text and flagged when confidence is low
does_not_demonstrate: real scanner or camera artefacts such as shadows, creases, stamps or handwriting

samples.title: Monthly stock report, text PDF (fictional)
samples.description: A one-page report with a heading, a few label: value lines and a ruled table of eight rows and five columns.
samples.provenance: Generated by services/document-ocr/scripts/make_samples.py for this demonstration; all content is fictional.
samples.licence: Created for this project; no third-party content.

samples.title: Clean test scan (Tesseract project test image)
samples.description: A 640 x 480 black-and-white TIFF of eight lines of 12-point text, used by the Tesseract OCR project to test its code. It is clean and binarised, so OCR on it is easy.
samples.provenance: testing/phototest.tif from https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/test (Apache-2.0 repository), unmodified. Transcribed by eye for the tests.
demonstrates: line boxes and confidences on real raster text
does_not_demonstrate: tables, fields or classification (it is plain prose)
